director.card: Board par teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: pehli 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.

director.text: tenth, seventh, quarter

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki chocolate jitne zyada tukdon mein kate, tukda utna chhota; isliye pehle 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4. Chalo, aaj ka ek aakhri sawaal, poore paath se. Is circle ke 9 barabar tukde hain, aur 4 tukdon mein rang hai. Rangin bhaag fraction mein kitna hai?

Haan, bilkul theek. Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki kisi cheez ke barabar tukdon ka hi fraction naam hota hai, aur neeche wala number saare barabar tukde ginta hai. Phir bahut saari cheezon ka fraction aaya: neeche wala number batata hai kitne barabar group banane hain, aur ek group ki ginti jawab hoti hai. Aakhir mein dekha ki ek jaisi cheez jitne zyada barabar tukdon mein kate, har tukda utna chhota hota hai. Tumne aakhri sawaal sahi kiya: rangin bhaag 4/9 hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
